body.x: EdTech company Firsthabit announced that it will participate in Global Innovation Forum 2026 (GIF 2026), a global startup networking and investor pitching event held alongside CES 2026, where it will deliver a technical presentation on its education-focused artificial intelligence model, CHALK.

GIF 2026 will take place on January 7, 2026, at the Emperors Ballroom of Caesars Palace in Las Vegas, bringing together startups, global media, venture capital firms, and startup support organizations from major innovation ecosystems, including South Korea, France, Switzerland, Japan, Taiwan, Canada, and Israel.

FIRSTHABIT is a CES Innovation Award–winning company, recognized in both the Artificial Intelligence and EdTech categories for its applied AI solutions in learning. At GIF 2026, the company’s pitch will be delivered by Changshin Lee, AI Engineering Lead at FIRSTHABIT, who brings extensive experience in large-scale AI systems and platform architecture.

Lee holds a master’s degree in computer science from Newcastle University in the United Kingdom and a bachelor’s degree in mathematics from Seoul National University. He previously served as CTO at Spoon Radio and Soldout, and as a development lead at Naver Music, where he oversaw the design and deployment of complex, large-scale systems. His background underpins FIRSTHABIT’s emphasis on technically grounded and implementation-oriented approaches to education AI.

body.cap: Changshin Lee, AI Engineering Lead at Firsthabit | Photo by Firsthabit

body.x: During the session, FIRSTHABIT plans to address why education-dedicated AI models are necessary in an era dominated by general-purpose, text-based large language models. The company argues that learning is not a simple process of information retrieval, but a continuous cycle of concept formation and reasoning that requires AI systems purpose-built for educational contexts.

FIRSTHABIT will introduce CHALK, an education-specific AI model built on a Visual LLM architecture. Unlike conventional text-based LLMs, CHALK integrates visual explanations, structured reasoning, and adaptive presentation methods, dynamically adjusting how concepts are explained based on each learner’s level of understanding. Built on an education-focused cognition model, CHALK is designed not as an answer-generating system but as a learning partner that supports and guides the learner’s thinking process.

FIRSTHABIT views GIF 2026 as a strategic platform to share its long-term vision as it prepares for a U.S. market launch in the coming year, positioning CHALK as a differentiated education AI model capable of competing in the global EdTech landscape.
